listing.name: Mod Ships (P) Pirate
listing.aiSummary: Adds new pirate ship variants with custom designs fitting the vanilla setting.

description:
Mod Ships (P) Pirate

Features
• New ship variants
• Custom ship designs
• Designed to fit the vanilla Starsector setting and gameplay

Ships (P)
Apogee P-Class          Champion P-Class
Medusa P-Class       Gemini P-Class
Grendel P-Class          Wayfarer P-Class

Each ship has an altered history

DOWNLOAD

Other Ships
More ships will be added here...

Requirements
• Starsector 0.98a-RC8
• No additional dependencies

Installation
1. Download the latest release.
2. Extract the Ships (P) Pirate folder.
3. Move it to your Starsector mods folder.
4. Launch Starsector.
5. Enable Ships (P) Pirate in the mod manager.

Known Issues
• None currently known.
